title: Multi-Agent Workflow System Action Plan
overview: Comprehensive action plan for maximizing the benefits of the multi-agent workflow system implemented for WordPress development at cFish.io, including team training, workflow integration, token optimization, and ongoing enhancement strategies.

implementationStatus.summary: All components have been verified and are ready for team adoption. The system provides a foundation for enhanced WordPress development through specialized agent roles, efficient token usage, and standardized workflows.

conclusion: The multi-agent workflow system provides a powerful framework for enhancing WordPress development at cFish.io. This action plan outlines a comprehensive approach to maximizing its benefits through team training, workflow integration, token optimization, and ongoing refinement. By following this phased implementation approach, we will achieve significant improvements in development efficiency, code quality, and resource utilization, ultimately enhancing our ability to deliver high-quality WordPress solutions for our clients.
